arppu.title: ARPPU by segment
arppu.content:
ARPPU (average revenue per paying user, CNY/month) measures how much each paying subscriber is worth. NetEase Cloud Music discloses it separately for its two segments: online music (subscription streaming) and social entertainment (live-streaming and virtual-gift-based services).

For NetEase Cloud Music Inc.: social entertainment ARPPU is far higher per user but has fallen sharply (CNY573.8 to CNY178.6, FY2020-FY2023) as the paying base grew roughly 5x -- new entrants monetize at a lower rate, diluting the average even as segment revenue has grown. Online music ARPPU has been comparatively flat (CNY6-8/month), reflecting a maturing subscription base. The company stopped disclosing both series after FY2023, so the chart is intentionally short.

What to watch:

  • Online music ARPPU stagnating despite subscriber growth (monetization ceiling)
  • Social entertainment ARPPU dilution outpacing paying-user growth, which would flatten or shrink segment revenue

socialEntPayingUsers.title: Social entertainment paying users
socialEntPayingUsers.content:
The number of paying users in the social entertainment segment (live-streaming, virtual gifting) -- a much smaller and higher-ARPPU base than the online-music subscriber count.

For NetEase Cloud Music Inc.: this base grew almost 5x from 0.33m to 1.60m FY2020-FY2023, the main driver of social entertainment revenue growth over that period even as per-user ARPPU fell (see the ARPPU chart). Disclosure stopped after FY2023.

What to watch:

  • Paying-user growth vs. the ARPPU dilution it causes -- net effect on segment revenue
  • Regulatory risk specific to live-streaming/virtual-gifting monetization in China

incomeTax.title: Income tax expense
incomeTax.content:
Income tax expense is the period's tax charge against pre-tax profit.

For NetEase Cloud Music Inc.: the tax line has been small and volatile relative to profit as the company turned profitable from FY2022 onward; FY2025's negative figure is a net tax benefit rather than a charge, likely reflecting prior-year true-ups or the recognition of previously unrecognised deferred tax assets as cumulative losses are absorbed.

What to watch:

  • Effective tax rate normalising toward the statutory PRC rate as one-off benefits roll off
  • Swings between expense and benefit distorting net income and net margin period to period

balanceSheet.title: Balance sheet
balanceSheet.content:
Shareholders' equity is assets less liabilities; plotted against total liabilities to show leverage.

For NetEase Cloud Music Inc.: equity that grows only through revaluations or share issues is not the same as retained earnings.

What to watch:

  • Liabilities growing faster than equity
  • Goodwill share of equity after acquisitions

cashDebt.title: Cash and debt
cashDebt.content:
Cash & equivalents against total borrowings (leases excluded unless noted).

For NetEase Cloud Music Inc.: the DCF's net-debt bridge uses these balances at the latest balance-sheet date.

What to watch:

  • Net debt trend versus EBITDA
  • Refinancing dates and covenants in the filings

ebitda.title: EBITDA
ebitda.content:
EBITDA is earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation -- an operating-cash proxy that ignores capital intensity.

For NetEase Cloud Music Inc.: read it beside CapEx: a business that must reinvest most of its EBITDA is not as cash-generative as the margin suggests.

What to watch:

  • EBITDA margin trend
  • Gap between EBITDA and operating cash flow (working capital)

epsDps.title: EPS and dividends
epsDps.content:
EPS is net income per share; DPS is the cash dividend paid per share. Both are in major currency units.

For NetEase Cloud Music Inc.: the payout ratio (DPS / EPS) shows how much of earnings is returned versus reinvested.

What to watch:

  • EPS growth versus net income growth (dilution)
  • Dividends funded from earnings, not debt

fcf.title: Free cash flow
fcf.content:
Reported FCF is operating cash flow less capital expenditure. Owner FCF (from the DCF) further deducts stock-based compensation, interest income and lease principal -- the cash an owner could actually take out.

For NetEase Cloud Music Inc.: the gap between net income and owner FCF is the earnings-quality question the valuation is built on.

What to watch:

  • FCF persistently below net income
  • Working-capital swings inflating one year's FCF

margins.title: Margins
margins.content:
Gross margin is revenue less cost of revenue; operating margin deducts operating expenses; net margin is after interest and tax.

For NetEase Cloud Music Inc.: the spread between gross and operating margin is the cost of running the business; a widening spread with flat gross margin means opex is growing faster than sales.

What to watch:

  • Direction of operating margin over several years, not one
  • One-offs (impairments, disposals) that distort net margin

ocfCapex.title: Operating cash flow and CapEx
ocfCapex.content:
Operating cash flow is cash generated by operations; CapEx is cash invested in fixed and intangible assets.

For NetEase Cloud Music Inc.: CapEx here is shown as stored (sign convention varies by ticker); the DCF splits it into stay-in-business and growth where disclosed.

What to watch:

  • CapEx rising faster than revenue
  • OCF that diverges from EBITDA

profit.title: Profit lines
profit.content:
Gross profit is revenue less cost of revenue; operating income deducts operating expenses; net income is after interest, tax and one-offs.

For NetEase Cloud Music Inc.: the three lines together show where margin is made and lost between the top line and the bottom.

What to watch:

  • Operating income growing slower than gross profit (opex creep)
  • Net income far from operating income (interest, tax, one-offs)

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.content:
Revenue is the top line: what customers paid for goods and services in the period, before any costs.

For NetEase Cloud Music Inc.: the growth rate matters more than the level; compare it with the DCF's base-case growth path below.

What to watch:

  • Acceleration or deceleration in YoY growth
  • Whether growth is organic or acquired
  • Interim rows show seasonality

sbc.title: Stock-based compensation and share count
sbc.content:
Stock-based comp is the expense of equity awards; shares outstanding shows the dilution it causes net of buybacks.

For NetEase Cloud Music Inc.: the DCF charges SBC as a cash cost and holds the share count flat, so this chart is the check on that assumption.

What to watch:

  • Share count rising while buybacks are advertised
  • SBC as a percentage of revenue
